parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Use the logarithm product or quotient law on each side, e.g. $\ln8^3+\ln8^{-6x}$ and $\ln4+\ln5^{-2x}$. [*B1] Use the logarithm power law involving $x$ on one side, e.g. $-6x\ln8$ or $-2x\ln5$. [DB1] Obtain a correct linear equation in $x$, e.g. $(3-6x)\ln8=\ln4-2x\ln5$; small errors only in the second or third decimal are allowed if decimals are used. [B1] Obtain $x=0.524$, exactly to 3 d.p.; no working scores 0/4, and the printed special-case maxima apply. [B1] The two printed index-law alternatives earn the same marks when the combined powers and required logarithm laws are shown. Total: 4.
